tools_helpful.evidence: Migration session turn 2 reran the bootstrap successfully and produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md, .bootstrap-meta.json, six threading TODOs, and file execution modes.
Migration session turn 4 fetched only the threading anchor and gave the agent the intended CoreDispatcher-to-DispatcherQueue recipe.

tools_problematic.tool: Parallel execution of the mandatory scaffold/bootstrap/self-check commands
tools_problematic.problem: The bootstrap and self-check ran before dotnet new winui finished.
tools_problematic.evidence: Migration session turn 1 returned Target not found and False; turn 2 had to rerun both operations after scaffold completion.

tools_problematic.problem: The source glob exposed 35 generated bin/obj files while the authored XAML was linked from outside the project directory.
tools_problematic.evidence: Migration session turn 6 listed 26 obj and 9 bin files but only three authored files at the project root; turns 7-10 then searched generated output and SharedContent manually.

tool_limitations.limitation: It enumerated only files physically below -Source and ignored explicit MSBuild items whose Include path pointed outside that directory.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse Compile, Page, ApplicationDefinition, Content, and AppxManifest items and copy existing linked files to their Link paths before triage.

failed_apis.why_tried: The effects scenario retained its bitmap-generation feature from the UWP source.
failed_apis.root_cause: The source referenced Win2D.uwp, but the target project did not replace it with the WinUI-compatible Microsoft.Graphics.Win2D package.
failed_apis.fix: Replace the UWP package ID with Microsoft.Graphics.Win2D while retaining the Microsoft.Graphics.Canvas namespaces.

failed_apis.why_tried: The six bootstrap TODOs correctly required replacing UI-thread dispatch calls.
failed_apis.root_cause: Files also imported Windows.System, which defines another DispatcherQueue type, so the unqualified name was ambiguous.
failed_apis.fix: Alias Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue and use that alias for fields and GetForCurrentThread calls.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 1 fidelity guidance and Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 Step 1
doc_errors.wrong: The mapping was treated as a complete inventory even though the bootstrap could not discover linked source items outside -Source.
doc_errors.correct: The bootstrap must resolve explicit linked MSBuild items and map their Link destinations before claiming the inventory is complete.

doc_errors.wrong: The generic instruction to carry third-party packages forward did not distinguish UWP-only integration package IDs.
doc_errors.correct: UWP-specific packages require a WinUI-compatible replacement; Win2D.uwp maps to Microsoft.Graphics.Win2D.

special_apis.special_handling: When the scaffold root namespace has the same identifier as a platform type, alias or fully qualify the platform type instead of renaming the whole project namespace.
Retain Windows.System when needed for Launcher, but alias the Microsoft.UI.Dispatching type to avoid CS0104.

errors_encountered.error: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: Target not found; self-check returned False
errors_encountered.root_cause: The three ordered bootstrap commands were issued in parallel, so bootstrap raced project scaffolding.
errors_encountered.fix: Run scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check sequentially; the agent recovered with one rerun.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234/CS0246 for Microsoft.Graphics.Canvas, CanvasDevice, CanvasRenderTarget, and CanvasDrawingSession
errors_encountered.root_cause: The target omitted the WinUI-compatible Win2D package while preserving code that depends on it.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'LampArray' is a namespace but is used like a type
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold namespace LampArray shadowed Windows.Devices.Lights.LampArray.
errors_encountered.fix: Alias Windows.Devices.Lights.LampArray and use the alias at every type and static-call site.

errors_encountered.error: CS0104: DispatcherQueue is ambiguous between Microsoft.UI.Dispatching and Windows.System
errors_encountered.root_cause: Both namespaces were imported and the migrated code used an unqualified type name.
errors_encountered.fix: Use a namespace alias for Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue.

errors_encountered.error: WMC1509, WMC0909, WMC1111, and WMC9999 around local:Scenario
errors_encountered.root_cause: Markup pass 2 had no successfully compiled local assembly because preceding C# compilation failed, so the local Scenario type could not be resolved and later XAML errors cascaded.
errors_encountered.fix: Fix the C# dependency and type-resolution errors first, then rebuild before changing otherwise-correct x:DataType markup.

errors_encountered.error: Migration timed out with builds=false and runs=false
errors_encountered.root_cause: The incomplete bootstrap forced manual recovery of linked shell/XAML/assets, consuming turns 6-15 before the agent ever built.
errors_encountered.fix: Copy linked project items during bootstrap and start the required build-fix loop immediately after each file batch.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap failed because its target did not exist.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One failed attempt and one successful retry.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Commands documented as ordered were dispatched concurrently.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent reran bootstrap after dotnet new winui completed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Execute the mandatory scaffold/bootstrap/self-check sequence serially.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched generated obj XAML, browsed the large SharedContent tree, and manually recreated shell pages, styles, and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately ten turns of discovery and reconstruction.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap copied only four physical files and omitted 17 linked project items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually located SharedContent and authored replacement files, but timed out before a build.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve linked MSBuild items automatically.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: No migration-time build or mandatory validator run occurred; scoring discovered all compiler failures.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manual source recovery displaced the prominent build-fix-validate loop.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migration trial.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Complete source inventory mechanically so the existing build-after-batch and mandatory validation rules can run within budget.

missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Manual discovery and reconstruction of App.xaml, MainPage, scenario XAML, styles, shared code, and assets across turns 6-15.
